subject: Clarification Needed: Proposed Group Activity Date
text:
Dear Project Manager,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing as a club member responsible for proposing our next group activity, and I wanted to clarify a scheduling confusion before we ask anyone to confirm attendance. After reviewing the shared calendar, I believed the activity was reserved for Thursday afternoon in the community room. I have now discovered that I misread the calendar entry: the highlighted block was for our social mixer, not the volunteer workshop we had planned.

I apologize for the confusion and for any inconvenience this may have caused. Because we have several members preparing materials, I would like to confirm the correct date and time before sending reminders. Would it be possible to schedule the workshop for Tuesday morning instead? If Thursday remains preferable, we can keep it and simply label the session correctly. I can also circulate a revised invitation with the correct details, a brief agenda, and a reminder about bringing reusable cups and gloves.

If the original Thursday slot was chosen to avoid conflicting with another community booking, I am happy to ask the caretaker for a short extension or move the activity to a nearby hall. Please send any constraints you already know so I can adjust the plan without creating another mix-up.

Please let me know what you would prefer, and I will make the changes immediately. Thank you for your guidance and for helping us keep the club's activities running smoothly.

Thank you for your time.

Kind regards,
Club Member
